summary: Oracle maintains robust cloud infrastructure security and effective financial controls, but faces elevated cyber risk due to severe zero-day exploitations in its legacy enterprise software suites. Recent active campaigns targeting PeopleSoft and E-Business Suite have caused widespread downstream customer breaches, compounding reputational damage from a disjointed response to a 2025 cloud incident. High internal workforce friction and massive AI infrastructure scaling further expand the company's operational and insider threat attack surface.
